data.display_address: Baccarat Hotel And Residences, Burj Khalifa Area, Downtown Dubai, Dubai
data.long_description:
"Baccarat Hotel & Residences is an exclusive luxury development in the heart of Dubai, offering 43 residential floors under the prestigious Sotheby’s agency. The project is a collaboration between Shamal Holding and H&H Development.

Inspired by the brilliance of Baccarat’s 250-year crystal legacy, the architecture embodies sophistication and refinement.

The development consists of two towers—one housing a five-star hotel with 144 elegant rooms and the other featuring high-end residences, including 2-4 bedroom apartments and 4-5 bedroom penthouses. Each home boasts a private balcony with breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai’s skyline.

Residents enjoy premium amenities, including a swimming pool with a panoramic terrace, a modern gym, a children's play area, and a selection of on-site cafés and restaurants.

Conveniently situated in central Dubai, Baccarat Residences is just five minutes from Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Fountain, and Dubai Opera. Key destinations like the Dubai Design District, Museum of the Future, Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah are within a 15-minute drive.

Every residence in the complex is meticulously designed with luxurious finishes, offering an opulent yet inviting living experience.
